function: Learned beamforming (precoder) for weighted sum-rate maximization in an FA-enabled multi-cell downlink MIMO, via GNN for a given random port selection (p. 3, p. 4).
system: 2 cells, 4 single-antenna UEs each; each BS has 4 fluid antennas with 6 ports; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, p. 8).
method: Multi-GNN (MLP, two GNN layers with max-pooling aggregation, FC); unsupervised training on negative WSR loss, centralized training, distributed inference; port selection is random, not learned (p. 4, p. 5).
data_channel: Own simulator: Jakes port correlation, path loss -30 dB at 1 m plus 25 log10(d/d0); 10,000 random samples per epoch, 2,000 test samples (p. 3, p. 8).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same random-channel distribution (power, BSs, UEs, ports swept); no stated train/test mismatch; retraining per setting not stated (p. 8, p. 9).
baselines: Non-learned: MMSE, ZF, MRT with 500 independent port selections. Learned: only variants of own GNN (RandomSingle, RandomMax, Exhaustive); no earlier learned method (p. 8).
metrics: Weighted sum-rate (WSR) vs power, BSs, UEs, ports; WSR distribution vs RPS trials; FPGA inference latency in clock cycles and ms (p. 9, p. 10, p. 11).
complexity: Order of GNN forward-pass complexity (p. 5); FPGA latency 3.926-6.104 ms for one port selection, 3.994-6.222 ms for four (p. 9, p. 11).
q1_support: p. 3: "Assuming rich scattering, the spatial correlation can be characterized by" a Jakes model; custom simulator with its own path loss (p. 8); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 8: "The test set contains 2, 000 samples." It is a held-out part of the same random channels; no model is stated to be tested on another scenario, UE count or band than in training.
q3_support: p. 8: "serving as a non-learning benchmark" (MMSE; ZF and MRT likewise); the only learned comparisons are GNN-RandomSingle, GNN-RandomMax and GNN-Exhaustive, variants of the proposed method, so no earlier learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 5: "The resulting computational complexity for this component is" followed by an O(...) expression; measured FPGA latency also reported (p. 9: 3.926 to 6.104 milliseconds).
q5_support: p. 8: "Each training epoch consists of 10, 000 randomly generated samples"; channels come from the own simulator, and the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: PDF is arXiv v1 (2507.14035, 18 Jul 2025), titled Toward Practical Fluid Antenna Systems: Co-Optimizing Hardware and Software for Port Selection and Beamforming; the PDF does not print the DOI, so its match to the DOI is not checked. Included: the GNN learns the BS precoder (area 3); port selection is random, not learned; the FPGA accelerator only runs inference. q2: p. 5 says the architecture generalizes to varying UE counts and Fig. 9 sweeps UEs, but no training UE count differing from testing is stated, so 0; reviewer may confirm.
